_comment: Generated music + sound design, no downloads. Times are on the video timeline and match the scene cuts in index.html (music sections start on the scenes; each sfx sits on the beat it accents). `showtime retime <project> -d <seconds>` moves the scenes, these times and the poster together; after editing one scene by hand, move its sfx 'at' with it. Swap the music for a library track with {"kind": "music", "lib": "<id>", "fit": true} (showtime audio lib search --kind music --mood uplifting).
